nodes.name: Webhook - Create Attribute
nodes.notes:
POST endpoint to create a new product attribute.
Accepts: name (required), slug (optional), type (optional, default: select), order_by (optional, default: menu_order)

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Create Attribute
nodes.notes:
Creates a new product attribute in WooCommerce.
Endpoint: POST /wp-json/wc/v3/products/attributes
Handles 'attribute_taxonomy_exists' error for duplicates.
